zh-CN.fields.name: 页面名称
zh-CN.title: 页面多语种
zh-CN.description: 企业元数据中心：按应用维护页面文案，保存草稿并发布后供前端读取语言包。
zh-CN.scope.title: 选择应用范围
zh-CN.scope.required: 请选择业务域、命名空间、环境和应用后查询页面
zh-CN.list.title: 页面语言包
zh-CN.empty.pages: 当前应用暂无页面语言包
zh-CN.feedback.forbidden: 当前身份无权执行此操作
zh-CN.feedback.pending: 正在保存或发布，请等待操作完成
zh-CN.feedback.refreshFailed: 无法刷新页面，请重试后继续操作
zh-CN.conflict.title: 草稿已被其他人修改，本地编辑已保留
zh-CN.conflict.description: 请比较服务器草稿后选择如何继续；不会自动覆盖本地内容。
zh-CN.conflict.loadServer: 放弃本地修改，加载服务器草稿
zh-CN.conflict.keepLocal: 我已比较，保留本地内容继续编辑
zh-CN.help.pageCode: 创建后不可修改。common 为公共语言包，页面文案可覆盖同名公共 key。
zh-CN.placeholders.pageCode: 例如 order.list；公共文案使用 common
zh-CN.help.publish: 保存后可发布；至少需要一条默认语言文案。
zh-CN.leave.title: 离开并放弃未保存的修改？
zh-CN.leave.pendingDescription: 请等待保存或发布完成，再离开页面。
zh-CN.leave.description: 当前页面存在未保存的草稿，离开后这些修改将丢失。
zh-CN.validation.localeLimit: 每个页面最多配置 32 种语言
zh-CN.entries.label: 页面翻译词条
zh-CN.preview.title: 已发布语言包预览
zh-CN.preview.description: 读取已发布文案并通过共享 i18n SDK 渲染。切换语言或刷新可查看公共文案合并和缺失翻译回退结果。
zh-CN.preview.stale: 刷新失败，当前显示上次成功加载的已发布文案
zh-CN.help.entries: 默认语言须填写每条文案。其他语言留空会按 key 回退到默认语言；{{example}} 等占位符须保持一致。移除语言或删除文案后，保存草稿并发布才会影响页面读取。
zh-CN.validation.locale: 请输入有效的语言代码，例如 zh-CN 或 en-US
zh-CN.validation.placeholderSyntax: 占位符格式无效，请使用 {{example}} 或 {{alternate}}
zh-CN.validation.name: 页面名称不能为空，且不能超过 128 个字符
zh-CN.validation.entryLimit: 每个页面最多配置 2000 条文案
zh-CN.validation.defaultLocale: 语言不能重复，且必须包含默认语言
zh-CN.validation.key: 文案 key「{{key}}」无效：使用字母、数字、下划线、短横线或点分段，且不超过 128 字符
zh-CN.validation.defaultText: 默认语言 {{locale}} 缺少「{{key}}」的文案
zh-CN.validation.textLimit: 「{{key}}」的 {{locale}} 文案不能超过 8192 个字符
zh-CN.validation.placeholders: 「{{key}}」的 {{locale}} 占位符必须与默认语言一致（例如 {{example}}）
zh-CN.validation.bundleSize: 页面语言包超过 2 MiB，请减少文案或拆分页面
zh-CN.validation.pageCode: 页面标识须为不超过 128 字符的字母、数字、下划线、短横线或点分段
zh-CN.admin.title: 管理台界面文案
zh-CN.admin.description: 在固定的管理台作用域中维护菜单与各页面文案。初始化只创建并发布缺失语言包，已有页面和草稿保持不变。
zh-CN.admin.initialized: 已创建 {{created}} 个语言包，跳过 {{skipped}} 个已有页面

en-US.fields.name: Page name
en-US.title: Page translations
en-US.description: Enterprise metadata center: manage page text by application, save drafts, and publish language bundles for frontend use.
en-US.scope.title: Select application scope
en-US.scope.required: Select a business domain, namespace, environment, and application to search pages
en-US.list.title: Page language bundles
en-US.empty.pages: No page language bundles for this application
en-US.feedback.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action
en-US.feedback.pending: Saving or publishing is in progress. Wait for it to finish
en-US.feedback.refreshFailed: Unable to refresh the page. Retry before continuing
en-US.conflict.title: Someone else modified this draft. Your local edits have been kept
en-US.conflict.description: Compare the server draft, then choose how to proceed. Local content will not be overwritten automatically.
en-US.conflict.loadServer: Discard local edits and load the server draft
en-US.conflict.keepLocal: I have compared the drafts; keep local content and continue editing
en-US.help.pageCode: Cannot be changed after creation. common is the shared language bundle; page text can override shared keys with the same name.
en-US.placeholders.pageCode: For example, order.list; use common for shared text
en-US.help.publish: Save before publishing. At least one entry in the default language is required.
en-US.leave.title: Leave and discard unsaved changes?
en-US.leave.pendingDescription: Wait for saving or publishing to finish before leaving the page.
en-US.leave.description: This page has unsaved draft changes. Leaving will discard them.
en-US.validation.localeLimit: Each page supports up to 32 languages
en-US.entries.label: Page translation entries
en-US.placeholders.translatedText: Leave blank to use the default language
en-US.empty.entries: No text yet. Add an entry
en-US.preview.title: Published language bundle preview
en-US.preview.description: Load published text and render it through the shared i18n SDK. Switch languages or refresh to inspect merged shared text and fallback translations.
en-US.preview.unpublished: Publish to preview the language bundle
en-US.preview.stale: Refresh failed. Showing the last successfully loaded published text
en-US.feedback.latestDraftFailed: Failed to load the latest draft: {{error}}
en-US.help.entries: Provide every message in the default language. Blank translations fall back to the default language by key; placeholders such as {{example}} must match. Removing languages or entries affects consumers only after saving and publishing.
en-US.validation.locale: Enter a valid language code, such as zh-CN or en-US
en-US.validation.name: Page name is required and must not exceed 128 characters
en-US.validation.entryLimit: Each page supports up to 2000 message entries
en-US.validation.defaultLocale: Languages must be unique and include the default language
en-US.validation.key: Invalid message key "{{key}}": use letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, or dot-separated segments, up to 128 characters
en-US.validation.defaultText: Default language {{locale}} is missing text for "{{key}}"
en-US.validation.textLimit: The {{locale}} text for "{{key}}" must not exceed 8192 characters
en-US.validation.placeholders: The {{locale}} placeholders for "{{key}}" must match the default language (for example, {{example}})
en-US.validation.bundleSize: The page language bundle exceeds 2 MiB. Reduce its text or split the page
en-US.validation.pageCode: Page code must use letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, or dot-separated segments, up to 128 characters
en-US.admin.title: Administration interface text
en-US.admin.description: Manage navigation and page text in the fixed administration scope. Initialization creates and publishes missing bundles while preserving existing pages and drafts.
